summary: Forest Service lookout on the Shawnee National Forest, Pope County, IL; a 100-foot steel tower near Brownfield, offered for sale in 1972; now listed as gone.

facts.design: 100-foot steel tower with a lookout cab
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; the sources read give no removal date.

visit.trail_note: No tower remains to climb. No source describes present-day access to the site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, no staffing history, no removal date, and no present-day description. The c.1942 description is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page from a county-history book, which I did not read. The brief's 30.5 m matches the 100-foot description. An unverified social media post says the tower stood on private land; not used. No new photos found.
